report:
T9 does not work when typing on android

### Describe the bug

When I create a new note the smartphone (android) keyboard does not offer T9 words during typing.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open browser on android device
2. Open and login memos demo
3. Create a new note and try typing something

### The version of Memos you're using

0.21.0

evidence.quote: The input method is what's on your device, and there's no way to change that option by memos webside. Could you take a check that if you can switch to T9 words on another website?

confirmation.quote: There was Samsung browser limitation. It disables T9 on incognito mode.

ambiguity: D is plausible (web editors commonly suppress keyboard suggestions via autocomplete/autocorrect/spellcheck attributes or custom input handling; the report says it happens in memos) vs A (mobile browser/keyboard behavior). The incognito/Samsung Internet detail appears only in a later comment.
decisive_code: web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/index.tsx: the editor is a plain <textarea> with only className/rows/placeholder/ref/onPaste/onInput - no autoComplete, autoCorrect, spellCheck or inputMode attributes; hooks/useAutoComplete.ts only intercepts the Enter key. Nothing in memos disables IME word suggestions, so the behavior comes from the browser/keyboard.
notes: boojack relabeled bug -> need more context; stale-closed as not_planned; reporter later posted the cause; no code change.

reviews.decidable_why: A triager could guess IME suggestions are client-side, but the incognito/Samsung cause is not in the report and memos' textarea attributes would need checking.
A missing IME suggestion on one Android keyboard suggests a client-side cause. But ruling out textarea attributes requires checking the source, and the Samsung incognito detail is not in the body.
